subject_identity_preserved.rationale: Shots 1-5 consistently show the same skateboarder in black clothing with blue shoes on a dark skateboard; shot 0 only shows the board/partial subject, so identity is less explicit but not contradictory.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots remain in the same wooden skate bowl with concrete flat bottom, blue coping/rails, trees, and the same park setting despite viewpoint changes.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Low concrete/bowl view and skateboard motion are present, but the rider is mostly out of frame.
Skateboarder carves up the curved wall, though the view reads more like a wide bowl view than a tight tracking side pan.
Skateboarder continues along the opposite wall, but the shot is not overhead and does not clearly show an ollie near the lip.
Behind-rider view, painted wall, acceleration, and turning action are clear.
The skateboarder crosses the bowl at speed, but the view is not strongly telephoto and motion streaking is limited.
Close view shows the rider and board stabilizing, but it is more rear/close-up than front three-quarter.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks subject or scene consistency; the main issues are caption/viewpoint mismatches, especially shot 2.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames show distinct camera positions and changing rider poses/actions, with no copied or frozen sequence pattern.
